thresholdEvidence.notes: All ten reaches use the existing conservative 300–2,000 cfs Verde planning band from RiverScout, with direct Clarkdale USGS 09504000 for the upper two and direct Camp Verde USGS 09506000 for the lower eight. The band is a planning cue, not a safety guarantee.

endpointAudit.notes: Coordinates and river-mile order come from the Friends of the Verde map. Difficult carries, park hours and private-bank limits are retained in each access note.

qualityControls.camping: nearby_basecamp or none on every card; no unsupported riverbank camping
qualityControls.access: mapped RAP water-edge anchors with carry and parking caveats
qualityControls.geometry: curated traces follow the published RAP sequence
qualityControls.duplicateReview: forward access-chain reaches only; one longer combination retained as a documented itinerary

validation.pending: Reconfirm current RAP hours, parking, carry, Forest Service or State Parks notices, weather, gauge trend and any temporary closure before deployment.
